solar-listed.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class A, A.2(g)
solar-listed.plain: Panels on a listed house are not permitted development. You need listed building consent.

solar-ca-wall.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class A, A.2(e)
solar-ca-wall.plain: In a conservation area, panels may not go on a wall, balcony or roof enclosure that faces a road. The roof is fine.

solar-pitched.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class A, A.2(c)
solar-pitched.plain: On a pitched roof, panels may stand up to 20 cm proud of the roof and may not go above the ridge.

solar-flat-art23.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class A, A.3(ba)
solar-flat-art23.plain: On a flat roof in a conservation area, ask the council first whether it needs to approve how the panels look.

ashp-listed.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class G, G.1(i)
ashp-listed.plain: A heat pump on a listed house or its land is not permitted development. You need listed building consent.

ashp-units.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class G, G.1(a) and (d)
ashp-units.plain: One outdoor unit for a house that shares a wall, two for a detached house. Each unit up to 1.5 cubic metres, and it must meet the MCS Planning Standards, including the noise limit.

ashp-ca-front.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class G, G.1(j)
ashp-ca-front.plain: In a conservation area, the unit may not go on a wall or roof that faces a road, or closer to the road than the house.

ashp-front-upper.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 14 Class G, G.1(k)
ashp-front-upper.plain: Outside a conservation area, the unit may not go on a wall that faces a road above the ground floor.

ewi-art23.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 1 Class A, A.2(a)
ewi-art23.plain: In a conservation area, covering any outside wall with render, stone, pebble dash, timber, plastic or tiles is not permitted development. It needs planning permission.

ewi-materials.clause: GPDO Sch 2 Part 1 Class A, A.3(a)
ewi-materials.plain: Outside a conservation area, it is permitted development if the finish looks similar to the walls you have now.

ewi-listed.clause: Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, s.7
ewi-listed.plain: Any work that changes the character of a listed building needs listed building consent.

inside-insulation.clause: Town and Country Planning Act 1990, s.55(2)(a)
inside-insulation.plain: Work that only affects the inside of a building is not development, so insulating from the inside needs no planning permission (listed buildings still need consent).

article-2-3-land.plain: Conservation areas, National Parks, National Landscapes, the Broads and World Heritage Sites count as protected land for these rules.

bus-standard.plain: Boiler Upgrade Scheme: £7,500 off an air source heat pump. Your MCS installer applies and takes it off the bill.

bus-off-gas.plain: Boiler Upgrade Scheme: £9,000 for homes off the gas grid that replace oil, LPG or coal heating.

vat-zero.plain: No VAT on installing solar panels, heat pumps or insulation in a home, until 31 March 2027.

seg.plain: Smart Export Guarantee: your energy supplier pays you for electricity you send back to the grid.

householder-fee.plain: If you need planning permission: a householder application costs £548 and councils usually decide within 8 weeks.
